Weekly public hunt log posting on LinkedIn (SE + EN) including the scorer misses - publishing the misses is what makes it credible.
Foo Cafe talk submitted (I read every one-star review of every AI job-application tool); union/local press pitches (Kollega, Ingenjoren, Sydsvenskan, Rapidus) sent - story first, product last.
UK Reddit participation follows the 90/10 + disclosure rules with several weeks of genuine participation before any own post; Swedish effort goes to Facebook groups via admins, not r/sweden.

owner_steps.text: Book the cohort session / alumni channel slot and run the live demo.
Start the weekly LinkedIn hunt log.
Submit the Foo Cafe talk; draft the press pitches.
Begin UK Reddit participation from the personal account with affiliation disclosed.

tasks.title: Research the a-kassa aktivitetsrapport format/cadence before any export feature is committed

acceptance.text: The current published Arbetsforordningen/Arbetsformedlingen requirements for the aktivitetsrapport (format, fields, cadence, submission channel) verified at source and written up with links and a date.
A build/no-build recommendation recorded: what an export from the existing applications table would need, and the institutional-distribution angle (a-kassor/unions) assessed.

owner_steps.text: Owner reads the research and decides whether the export becomes a WO.

tasks.title: Evaluate Fantastic.jobs ATS feed (and the Phase-1 direct-ATS-adapter alternative) at its trigger conditions

acceptance.text: Trigger check written down first: UK user growth, or users reporting jobs we miss on career pages/LinkedIn, or ~50-100 paying users - do not buy before a trigger fires.

Scoped volume sized via the free count endpoints (/active-ats-count, /active-jb-count with our real Malmo/Lund + UK filters) and priced against the margin model; the credit traps (per-returned-job credits, union-scope ingestion, UK enterprise tier) addressed in the sizing.
Brand-promise tension resolved consciously: ATS-feed-only vs ToS vetting vs amending the official-public-data line; the Phase-1 direct public ATS adapters option costed alongside.

owner_steps.text: Owner decides adopt/defer after the sizing lands.

tasks.title: Send-from-own-Gmail as a submit method - the dispatch path behind the approval gates

acceptance.text: A user with a connected Composio Gmail entity can submit an approved draft from their own address as a new application method; nothing sends without the existing approval gates (PRD rule 1).
Two-tenant trap: user A Gmail connection can never send user B draft; disconnection degrades to the existing email/manual paths, never a silent failure.
Reply coverage: replies already land in the user inbox via reply_to - the outcome layer scan path works unchanged for Gmail-sent mail (one integration test).

check.ref: outcome-scan integration test for the new method

owner_steps.text: Approve writing the dispatch path (tracked outside the queue in the CLAUDE.md open items; the Composio connection is proven in production 2026-08-31).

slices.text: New submit method via Composio Gmail send behind the approval gates + tenant/degradation tests
